title: Keep Linux ROM coverage available when the target mount is unwritable
changes: Route the Linux coverage launcher logs, build context, dataset cache and default report to the ignored out/rom-coverage workspace when the target or its log directory is unwritable. Continue honoring explicit output and dataset arguments.
Document the output locations and reuse target when it becomes writable. Retain the existing terminal error and fallback-log behavior if the selected workspace cannot be created.
validation: On 25 November, a real Linux Docker run generated the EUR e333-d332 report from commit d5d54955 with 156 verified resource families. HTML embedded data and JSON agree, and the dataset manifest hash matches the report.

Ten mocked Docker launcher tests passed. After the final default-path change, normal and fallback routing tests, Bash syntax and help checks passed; validation receipts retained under out/rom-coverage/target/validation/units.
limitations: The external image returned an input/output error and its target bind was inactive on 25 November. This fix supplies a writable coverage workspace and does not repair the external disk.
The generated report has 108 resource families awaiting evidence review and no imported scene audits. PowerShell and native Windows behavior were outside this Linux change.
